prebossNodes.description: Number of pre-boss depths visited on a path; branching alternatives do not add levels.

restsPerAct.description: Number of mandatory rest depths; each rest depth has one visible node shared by every path.

branchColumns.description: Number of lanes at non-rest depths. Rest and boss nodes merge the lanes.

minimumThreatFloor.description: Earliest depth that may contain an elite or the final boss.

mapMode.description: Map visibility policy for configured routes; fog reveals the trail and next choices.

firstFloor.description: Node type every lane on depth 1 is forced to; null leaves depth 1 to the ordinary draw. It must be one of the route's alternatives, and depth 1 cannot also be a rest depth.

floorTypes.description: Depth to room type, like { "4": "shop" }: every node on that depth is that type, in every act. The depth is a whole number from 1 to prebossNodes and never a depth a rest can land on; the type is one of the route's types, never rest or boss; an elite needs minimumThreatFloor. Empty or null pins nothing.

placedTypes.description: Room types the map builder places itself (rests from restFloors, the boss last). floorTypes cannot pin them. Fixed.

firstBranchDepth.description: First depth of each branch's own lanes; depth 1 is the shared start node. Fixed.

earliestFullDepth.description: Earliest depth by which every lane of a branch is open.

fullDepthsBeforeBoss.description: Every lane of a branch is open by this many depths before the boss (or earliestFullDepth, if later).

narrowDepthsBeforeBoss.description: A wide branch may close one lane within this many depths before the boss.

first.description: First depth of the guaranteed shop.

last.description: Last depth of the guaranteed shop.

guaranteedShopDepths.description: Depths that hold each branch's guaranteed shop (shopsPerBranch).

routeShape.description: Branch-shape numbers the branched map builder and the floorTypes checks share. Defaults keep today's maps.

shopShare.description: Share of randomly typed nodes (not rest, elite, boss or the forced first floor) that are shops; the rest keep the even event/fight/treasure split. Absent keeps the even draw over every alternative.

maxBranches.description: Present: after a shared opening depth the act splits into 1..min(maxBranches, distinct bosses) branches, each with its own lanes, rests, elites and boss. Absent keeps a single trunk with one boss.

fogTrailOnly.description: With mapMode fog: only the travelled path, the nodes one step ahead of the node you stand on, the entrance and the bosses are lit. Branches off earlier nodes and the next rest stay fogged. Absent, false or null keeps the older fog.

fogRevealRests.description: With mapMode fog: every rest site (type shrine) of the act is lit through the fog from the start, in addition to the trail, the split ahead, the doors and the boss. Nothing else ahead is revealed. Absent, false or null keeps the plain fog.

startNodeRefills.description: Entering the branched map's single start node (one that carries refill: true) restores HP to full and refills both flasks. Only the branched generator (maxBranches) reads it. Default true.

requirePrebossRest.description: Require the last preboss depth to be a mandatory rest on every route.

typeWeights.description: Present: a free node (not rest, not forced, not a guaranteed slot) is a weighted draw over the listed types permitted at its depth (elite only at or past minimumThreatFloor); shopShare is ignored. Only the branched generator reads it. null means absent.

variedNeighbours.description: True: a free node may not repeat the type of the node already made in the neighbouring lane of the same branch and depth, when another permitted type has positive weight. null means absent.

shopsPerBranch.description: 1: each branch gets one guaranteed shop slot on a non-rest depth 4-8 where one of its lanes exists, never on a guaranteed elite slot. null means absent.

forkPercent.description: Chance per boundary node per depth that a branch widens outward. Absent keeps 40. null means absent.

crossLinkPercent.description: Present: for every gap between two in-branch depths and every pair of neighbouring lanes present on both, one draw at this percentage adds one diagonal edge (direction 50/50, never crossing another edge). Replaces the single remerge draw per branch and gap. null means absent.

narrowPercent.description: Chance per late depth that a branch narrows by one lane before the boss. Absent keeps 25. null means absent.

openingBranchWidthPercent.description: Chance that a branch with 2+ lanes opens on 2 lanes instead of 1 at the first branch depth. Absent keeps 50. null means absent.

startRestFromAct.description: First act whose depth-1 start node is a Rest (when restFloors lists depth 1). Earlier acts open on the depth-1 node drawn by firstFloor. null means every act.

restGap.description: Non-rest nodes allowed between two rests on a path, start counted as a rest when depth 1 is not one. The gap that ends at the pre-boss rest is not limited. null means absent.

restFloorSpread.description: Each rest depth other than depth 1 and the pre-boss depth may move up to this many depths either way per seed and act, within restGap. null means fixed.

branchSpread.description: V spread: each branch's centre moves away from the board centre by this many times its distance from it, growing linearly to the boss depth, so the board widens with depth. null means none.

singlePrebossRest.description: True: each branch's pre-boss depth is ONE rest node reached from every lane of the branch and linked only to its own boss. null means absent.

fogCommittedBranch.description: With mapMode fog: once the player has left the start node, the bosses of the other branches are fogged. null means absent.
